Method of Attack: Malicious Firefox browser extension designed to hijack Gmail accounts and infect victims with Scanbox malware
Hijacks Gmail accounts to search, read, archive, label, mark as spam, delete, forward emails, send mail from compromised account
Modifies Firefox browser permissions to access user data for all websites, display notifications, read and modify privacy settings, access browser tabs
Delivered via phishing emails redirecting to attacker-controlled you-tube[.]tv domain with fake Adobe Flash Player Update landing page
Uses social engineering to trick victims into installing the malicious add-on
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with redirection to fake Flash update page
Installation of malicious Firefox extension FriarFox
JavaScript profiling scripts prompting installation if Firefox and logged into Gmail
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Scanbox malware reconnaissance framework
